items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: Titus Turner was a singer of sorts, and he was performing with the band.

ctx.x: Titus Turner was a singer of sorts, and he was performing with the band. And I don’t know what he did to get everybody upset. But everybody was very upset at Titus. And somebody cooked up the plot: we ain’t playing, you know, behind this guy. And I think Marhsall kicked off the tune, and all of a sudden everybody was just sitting there.
